name: Volatile Stormdrake — B is an opponent's creature without protection from blue; a protected one exchanges nothing
notes: "When this creature enters, exchange control of this creature and target creature an opponent controls." (2026-10-18.) The list (getExchangeControlCandidates, fire-time snapshot) holds the opponent's Hill Giant, not your Grizzly Bears and not Karoo Meerkat (protection from blue; the Stormdrake is blue, CR 702.16). A pair set with the Meerkat is refused by the engine. Before, the list held your own creatures too and the Meerkat was exchanged.
